Very disappointing experience. I have ordered products 3–4 times from Myntra, but each time I had to return them because the fabric quality was poor and did not match my expectations. The product images look much better than the actual items received. It has been a waste of time and effort. Myntra should pay more attention to quality control."

Please don’t buy anything from Myntra. If you return the product, they deduct the “Bank Discount Applied” amount from your refund. This wasn’t clearly mentioned in the return policy or terms when purchasing. Only when you try to return the item do they inform you about the deduction. This is not transparent pricing or a fair return policy - it’s misleading and confusing for customers. By the way, their customer care is a bot. Good luck with that too.

I have been shopping on Myntra since 2009–10 and was a loyal customer for over 15 years. Recently, the quality has declined significantly. Many listings create the impression of premium brands, but the products I received often came from unfamiliar labels with poor stitching, finishing, and fabric quality. Returns and customer support have also been frustrating. Sadly, I no longer trust the platform and have decided to stop shopping here.

Very disappointed with this purchase. I used a coupon that said “non-returnable but exchangeable,” so I expected I could at least exchange the product if needed. However, after receiving it, there was a fitting issue and no exchange option was available. Customer care said it’s just the coupon name, which is misleading. Also, the product still shows “returnable till a date,” creating confusion. Not transparent at all.

Be very careful with online orders, especially the ones of higher value. The courier of Myntra will try to replace the order with an inferior/duplicate product or completely deliver somebody else's order. If one is not cautious, you might land up accepting the wrong order. Once you are able to see through things and cancel the product, Myntra exposes its intent by siphoning off the discounted amount added with the platform fees in the barge of illegal and hidden 'return policies'. Save yourself
